description: The 1860 Bucks County household behind M7QZ-8KD, for ut_search_records_027. Stocked to stop an ABORT, not for realism: record_read is not in the harness's LIVE_TOOLS, so with no fixture the tool is never registered and any call to it is a Type 1 uncovered call that aborts the run at exit 2 (observed in run v1_2026-08-13_22-11-11, where the skill read the top hit and the whole test died ungraded). That test's judge_context says such a call yields fixture_not_found; it does not. Keeps the test's premise intact — the household names George and two children, and NO spouse.
